description: Model upgrade banner: dismissing records the pair and hides the banner. The server offers an upgrade from the predictable model to a newer "Predictable Next" (ID predictable-next); dismissing it (POST /api/model-upgrade/dismiss) is faked, and afterwards the server's model list no longer offers it. Call "dismissed" returns the JSON body of the first dismiss request, or "none". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The element with data-testid "model-upgrade-banner" should be visible. 3. Call "dismissed": it must return exactly "none". 4. Click the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-dismiss". 5. Call "dismissed" until it returns exactly {"from":"predictable","to":"predictable-next"}. 6. There must then be exactly 0 elements with data-testid "model-upgrade-banner".
